# For Player Variable

Source: [4384](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4384); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [For Player Variable](../../api/actions/for-player-variable.md).

<a id="wiki-4384-n1"></a>
